identity.promise: An ordered whole-set grid stays compositionally stable while authored registration marks move attention from cell to cell; focus never becomes a generic card zoom.
identity.antiMotion: Contact Sheet is not masonry, a card swarm, a lightbox launcher, an illuminated Light Table, a periodically rebuilt grid, or Focus Strip folded into rows. It never reorders sources to fill visual gaps, shifts cells during attention, zooms the selected card, brightens/dims artwork, or hides the whole-set context.
identity.topology: opaque paper surface with non-overlapping ordered cells
identity.focusGrammar: whole set remains visible; traversal moves inspection mark/order
identity.finaleGrammar: whole-set composition resolves as one sheet

sourcePolicy.identityAndOrder: must survive failure, replacement, reverse and recycling

orientation: row, serpentine, column traversal on grid
